  B)         Consider the given grammar and the string "The bird chased the dog in the garden".  
  Using CKY parsing algorithm parse the string and show the recognition table.  
  
  S -> NP VP  
  NP -> Det N | NP PP  
  VP -> V NP | VP PP                                                                             (5)  
  PP -> P NP  
  Det -> a | the  
  N -> dog | bird | garden  
  V -> chased | caught  
  P -> in | with  
  
  C)         Use the following grammar rules create the top-down parse tree for the sentence "the  
  quick brown fox jumped over the lazy dog".

  NP -> Det Adj Adj N  
  VP -> V P Det Adj N  
  Det -> "the"                                                                                   (2)  
  Adj -> "quick" | "brown" | "lazy"  
  N -> "fox" | "dog"  
  V -> "jumped"  
  P -> "over"
